ISEN 613 | Engineering Data Analysis | Fall 2026
Instructor: Joseph Geunes | geunes@tamu.edu
Meets: N/A | Online
Grading: Homework [30%], Midterm Exam [35%], Final Project [35%] — A: 90-100%, B: 80-89.9%, C: 70-79.9%, D: 60-69.9%, F: below 60%
Topics: LDA, QDA, KNN, Bootstrap, LASSO, PCA, Ridge regression, Support vector machines, Tree-based methods, Subset selection, Cross validation, logistic regression, Linear regression, Clustering, predictive modeling, statistical models for engineering applications, developing new techniques, implementing existing techniques, real-world problems, comprehensive and insightful review study, emerging area of statistical learning, data mining, statistical learning, probability, data analysis for quality in engineering problems, measurement principles, data collection, quality engineering problems, assurance sciences, reliability, maintainability, quality control, robust design, statistics
Tools: Python, Canvas
